newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: C.BANK WILL SEEK BANKRUPTCY FOR TAURAS BANK.
newsitem.headline: C.BANK WILL SEEK BANKRUPTCY FOR TAURAS BANK.

text.p: Lithuania's central bank said on Tuesday that it would seek to have bankruptcy proceedings launched against the insolvent Tauras Bank.
"The board of the bank of Lithuania...has decided to apply to the Vilnius district court to initiate bankruptcy procedures for the insolvent Tauras Bank," the central bank said in a statement.
The central bank said Tauras Bank was insolvent and that its net assets were less than its liabilities by 39.56 million litas.
The central bank removed the board of Tauras Bank last month and imposed restrictions on most of its activities after it ran into liquidity problems.
The bank's president, Genadijus Konopliovas, was found dead on June 23 with a bullet wound to the head in what police suspect was a suicide.
Konopliovas was one of the main owners of the bank.
Tauras Bank admitted last month that it was having serious liquidity problems and was pinning its hopes on a 40 million litas share issue.
